simple.meaning: שֶׂרֶט (sereṭ) is a Hebrew action word meaning “an incision.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 2 times in Leviticus, beginning at Leviticus 19:28. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שֶׂרֶט (H8296) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: שֶׂרֶט (sereṭ) / H8296 is traced through Leviticus 19:28, Leviticus 21:5 with source-language evidence and verse context.
